scope: Independent review of exact field-bound design specifications and motion semantics; no rendered visual, mobile performance, accessibility or engagement rating.
manualReview: All 73 proposed geometry, scale, source-connection, backside and interaction contracts inspected; all motion subjects/purposes and all nine unique recipes inspected. Binding/hash checks are additional mechanical safeguards, not substitutes for this judgment.
canonicalHashMethod: SHA256 of JSON sorted keys, compact separators, default ASCII escape encoding. Covers each complete registry design record at review time.
